title: security: a session the ADR-0069 auth gate holds can still be served by the storage route family (detail withheld under the disclosure ruling)
body:
**P0 suspect (security):** a session the ADR-0069 auth gate HOLDS (it must remediate first) was measured to be served by a route of the storage family, which the family's own text says it must not be. Grade: triage's. **Filed by** the `domain:cli` seat 1 (#6024) · `zhuangjianguo` · session `session_01SYEJqDL3NXxrJRBVqaMu9T`, from #23217 slice 4's dev report (`class: b`). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

**Measured, detail withheld pending maintainer.** The maintainer's disclosure ruling (2026-08-18, recorded on #9387) says no reproduction for an authentication or authorization hole is published anywhere on GitHub. On the booted `StorageServicePlugin`, a held session was measured to get a successful answer from a storage route, where the same session alone is refused by the family's gate. It is identical on `origin/main` and on PR #24364's head, so that PR neither causes nor fixes it. The reproduction stays with the filing seat and the maintainer.

## Where (read on objectstack `origin/main`)

- `packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-service-plugin.ts`, `buildAuthGateSessionReader`: the family's ADR-0069 gate reader. It runs before every storage route.
- `packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.ts`, `requireDownloadSession` / `requireUploadSession` → `buildAuthSessionResolver`: how a route of the family identifies its caller.
- The gate and the route do not judge the same credential. The upload routes share the resolver; they were read from source, not measured.

## Governing text

- ADR-0069, and the family door's own text in `storage-routes.ts`: "A session the policy HOLDS ... is gated out of every protected resource until it remediates, and every route of this family is one".
- #23287's ruling C′ (`6159450584`, maintainer 「同意」), item 3: "REST and the dispatcher drop the cookie re-read after a key has admitted a user; the five raw-host families take the same answer through the shared seam." The storage family's gate takes the key's answer, but its routes still identify the caller by the cookie. This card is the storage residual of #23287's family (closed `completed` 2026-10-14); it is filed new rather than reopened so that the landed PRs stay on the closed card.

## Expected

The gate judges the credential the route actually serves, so a held session is refused on every route of the family whatever else the request carries. Pin it on the download and upload routes.

## Bearing on #23217

#23217's item-3 question (the gate reader is a second copy of the one composition's gate decision; slice 4's report `6252058631`) waits on this card's design. Choosing which credential the gate judges per route is the parameter a shared gate decision would need.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` (closed included), "storage auth gate held session ADR-0069 buildAuthGateSessionReader api key download" and "ADR-0069 auth gate password expired MFA required bypass route held session served". The near hits are #23287 (the parity card this one continues, closed), #23178 and #23190 (the raw-host families gaining the gate, closed), #24299 (the key-store read failure, open, a different defect), and #16839 and #23335 (other gate gaps, closed). No open card covers it. Control: the first query returns #24299 (open), so the search reaches the subject. Dedupe words: storage ADR-0069 gate held session served; buildAuthGateSessionReader session-only resolver; requireDownloadSession auth gate.
